title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Designation: Talent Acquisition Specialist
 Experience: 3 - 5 Years Shift Time: 02.30 PM - 12.30 AM
 Department: Human Resources Talent Acquisition
 Hiring Scope: India & USA
 Education: Bachelor's/Master's in HR, Business Administration, or relevant field 
 Job Summary We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist with 35 years of experience in India and USA recruitment to manage end-to-end hiring activities. The candidate will be responsible for sourcing, screening, interview coordination, stakeholder management, and ensuring timely closures of open positions. 
 Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end recruitment for India and USA positions . Source candidates through LinkedIn, Indeed, job portals, referrals, databases, and other channels. Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate screening calls. Coordinate interviews with candidates and hiring managers. Evaluate candidates based on skills, experience, communication, availability, and job requirements. Handle candidate communication, offer follow-up, and joining coordination. Maintain active talent pipelines for current and future requirements. Coordinate with hiring managers and provide regular recruitment updates. Maintain recruitment trackers, ATS records, and hiring reports. Support employer branding, job postings, and recruitment initiatives. Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process. 
 Required Skills 3–5 years of hands-on recruitment experience. Strong experience in US & Indian recruitment . Good sourcing and Boolean search skills. Experience with LinkedIn, Indeed, job portals, and ATS . Good understanding of USA work authorization terminology. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills. Good organizational, multitasking, and follow-up abilities. Target-oriented and capable of managing multiple requirements simultaneously. Preferred male candidates. 
 Key Performance Areas Timely closure of open positions. Quality and relevance of candidates submitted. Candidate pipeline development. Interview and offer-to-joining conversion. Hiring manager satisfaction. Recruitment reporting and process compliance.

Key Skills: Talent Acquisition,Hiring,Sourcing,End to End Recruitment,Talent Sourcing,Head Hunting,Hunting,Recruitment
